source: MSC Datamart HRDPS continental 2.5 km rotated lat-lon GRIB2 product
time_policy: HRDPS publishes HGT_Sfc at every lead: decoded at every valid time and required invariant. The land mask and the ice analysis exist only at the analysis lead (PT000H) and ride the primary inputs as cycle_invariant mapped fields, as GDPS's do.
member_policy: HRDPS is deterministic; no member identity exists
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
